nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.cluster_upload
========================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.cluster_upload

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   SFTP upload of qvtpy DICOM trees from workstation to cluster storage.

   Prompt for cluster SSH credentials; return ``(host, user, password)``.


.. py:function:: verify_ssh_connection(*, host: str, user: str, password: str, port: int = 22) -> None

   Open and close an SSH/SFTP session to confirm cluster access.


.. py:function:: remote_subject_dicom_dir(remote_dicom_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> str

   POSIX path ``<remote_dicom_root>/<subject>`` on the cluster.


.. py:function:: local_subject_has_dicoms(local_subject_dir: pathlib.Path) -> bool

   True if *local_subject_dir* exists and contains at least one entry.


.. py:function:: remove_local_subject_dicoms(local_subject_dir: pathlib.Path) -> None

   Delete a subject DICOM tree from local staging storage.


.. py:function:: upload_subject_dicoms(local_subject_dir: pathlib.Path, remote_dicom_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str, *, host: str, user: str, password: str, port: int = 22, skip_if_remote_nonempty: bool = True) -> bool

   Upload one subject DICOM tree to the cluster qvtpy layout.


.. py:function:: upload_subjects_dicoms(local_paths: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.paths.QvtpyPaths, cluster_paths: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.paths.QvtpyPaths, subjects: list[str], *, host: str, user: str, password: str, port: int = 22, skip_if_remote_nonempty: bool = True) -> None

   Upload DICOM trees for all *subjects* to the cluster layout.


.. py:function:: stream_subjects_xnat_to_cluster(subjects: list[str], *, local_paths: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.paths.QvtpyPaths, cluster_paths: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.paths.QvtpyPaths, xnat_config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig, sequences: Iterable[str], host: str, user: str, password: str, skip_existing: bool = False, skip_existing_downloads: bool = False, delete_local_after_upload: bool = True, port: int = 22) -> dict[str, dict[str, list[pathlib.Path]]]

   Per subject: XNAT download → cluster SFTP upload → delete local DICOM staging.

   SSH is verified before any XNAT download. A single SFTP session is reused for
   the full subject loop.


.. py:function:: remote_subject_results_dir(remote_results_root: pathlib.Path | str, subject: str) -> str

   POSIX path ``<remote_results_root>/<subject>`` on the cluster.


.. py:function:: fetch_subject_results_sftp(sftp: Any, *, remote_results_root: pathlib.Path | str, local_subject_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> dict[str, int]

   Download remote ``eicab/`` and ``qvtpy/`` into *local_subject_root*.

   Returns ``{resource_label: n_files_downloaded}``.


.. py:function:: remove_local_subject_results(local_subject_root: pathlib.Path) -> None

   Delete a staged subject results tree from local storage.
